name: scs-v2-sealed-confirmation-acquisition
title: SCS v2 sealed confirmation acquisition
description: Discover 3-5 previously unexposed official SCS cruises from metadata and deployment geometry only, then acquire their raw archives as opaque sealed bytes with reproducible provenance and independent verification.
creator: Ruichen Zhou
notes: Stage A commit 948519b, Stage A.1 commit b6de3a6, and Stage A.2 commit 7359f47/run 20260805T221441Z are retained. Stage B.0 hardening completed in authoritative offline readiness run 20260805T224911Z with verification=pass, 13 tests, 768/768 frozen Last-Modified values, and network/download/body-read counts all zero. The immutable primary set remains EQT20210702, EQT190012, EQT180002, TN352: 768 objects, 9,626,893,507 bytes, 5,606.374147 km, below 12 GiB. The downloader now fails before body read on resolved URL or Last-Modified drift, binds the safe run ID/fixed root/downloader/verifier/A.2 hashes, emits failed_unsealed receipts, and has an independent post-download verifier. confirmation_role_eligible=false; actual Stage B and all Stage C access remain unauthorized.
